svg.title: Engineering drawing of Rene Vincent Cosme's work, drawn in on load. Business systems: React and Vite, Node and Express, SQLite and Postgres, with 4,000+ automated checks on the ANF system (4,170, all passing, in September 2026); requests flow between them. AI systems: EyeDTrack, a Kotlin phone app and a Python server that finds the face with dlib's 68 facial landmarks, with 1,200+ automated checks; camera frames travel the pipeline in 713 milliseconds from camera capture to result, the 95th percentile on one phone at a desk in November 2026, and the loop runs to that time. Timeline: co-founded Pookies August 2023, led the EyeDTrack thesis February 2025, Highly Succeed internship March 2026, built the ANF system May 2026, Araneta City web internship July 2026, marked as the latest revision.
